text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a local hospital, Mejiro Ardan and
Yaeno
Muteki are performing in a play
sponsored by
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Are you gonna be Cinderella
today?!

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text: I can't do it right now but... I love dancing! I can't wait to see Cinderella's big dance scene!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, please do look forward to it. I
shall
endeavor to do the part justice.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ardaaan, we're starting soooon!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... the perfect balance of beauty
and
grace. You two were born to play
Cinderella and
the prince!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... Oh, and Ardan, please don't
change
into these glass slippers until just
before you go
on stage.
choice_data_list: ああ、2人とも決まってるぞ！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, both of you look sharp!
Yeah, both of you look wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. It would be a terrible shame
if one
were to crack all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan takes a good look at the
glass
slippers placed at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're perfectly safe! As I
explained earlier,
we've reworked the
slipper scenes so Cinderella
won't have
to move much at all!

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Like in the ball scene, rather than taking
up the
prince's invitation to dance,
Cinderella declines
with a dignified "no,
thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame that we had to cut the
dance scene,
but we can't have any
actors getting injured!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...You can trust me. Even if I'm to attend
a ball in
a pair of glass slippers...
choice_data_list: ならいいけど……無理はしないようにな
ならいいけど……無理はしないようにね
choice_data_list_en: Well, okay then... just don't push yourself too hard.
Well, okay then... just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can think of nobody more suited to
keeping
those slippers intact than
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The show proceeds without a hitch... and

eventually, the ballroom scene begins...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
May I have the honor of a dance with a
beautiful
lady?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, you may.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cinderella dances with featherlight
footwork.
Even as she dances in glass
slippers that could
break at any second,
her graceful smile never
leaves her face.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I'm amazed that she's pulling off
those
graceful, flowing movements
without firmly
planting her feet. That's
incredibly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Most would be gritting their teeth... but
she's
smiling from ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text: Wowww! Her dancing is so, so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll be able to dance again
someday... I
really wanna!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan! If we dance any longer—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Apologies, Princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki seizes the perfect moment
and
swiftly sweeps Mejiro Ardan off her
feet. The
curtain falls with Mejiro Ardan
in Yaeno Muteki's
arms and the glass
slippers in perfect condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I must apologize. To the cast and the
crew, to
Yaeno, and also to you, Trainer.
I went brazenly
off-script during the
performance.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I don't mind at all! No one got hurt
and the
show was captivating... But I'm
curious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wished to be a beacon of hope... for
the children
who are stuck in their
sickbeds.
choice_data_list: ……どうして踊ろうと思ったんだ？
……どうして踊ろうと思ったの？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I hoped to show them the courage
needed to take
that first step... rather
than the sight of a young
girl shrinking
away as she clutches her fragile
glass
slippers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I thought... that would be the best thing
I could
do for them right now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Verily. The fighting spirit I sensed in you
during
that performance... was the very
same spirit you
display when you race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Beautiful, noble, and above all else, fierce. Thus... I wished to aid you, however I could, in your display of courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Am I deserving of such praise?
choice_data_list: 確かに、輝くようなダンスだった
次からは相談もしてほしい
choice_data_list_en: True, that was a truly dazzling dance.
I'd like you to consult me first next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I assumed I would be
admonished for
my behavior.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So to hear that from you... I—

text_block_list.name: Girl on Crutches
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Cinderella! There you are! Your dance was amazing! And I wanted to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You... came all the way from your room
to find
me? Hehe, I'm hardly one to talk,
but that's rather
audacious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kind words. If I
contributed in
some way to your
standing on your own once
again, then
I'm content.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Mejiro Ardan has really
given her the
energy and courage to
take that first step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I'm still worried she'll end up hurting
herself...
I decide to remind her that she
really must be
more careful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...
choice_data_list: 一緒に考えることだってできる
choice_data_list_en: I can think about it with you, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry... Yes, I should have
known you'd
say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I should have simply consulted with you

beforehand rather than assuming I'd be
taken to
task... I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am truly sorry... And... I am grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...If another such opportunity arises,
please offer
your input. I shall seek your
counsel before
anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see two sides to Mejiro Ardan—the one
that
calmly owns up to her mistake and
apologizes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the one whose intense enthusiasm
drives her
to dive in with no regard for
what might happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That combination of prudence and
intensity is her
weakness, but perhaps
it's part of her charm, too.
